name: Happy Path — All Valid Inputs, Direct Dates
goal: User completes UK visa invitation letter request with all valid and direct inputs, receives confirmation.
constraints: User provides all required information in correct format on first attempt. Dates are full and valid, no clarifications needed.

phases.description: Agent initializes variables, workflow returns 'Show Cards', user selects 'London' as embassy city.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays embassy selection, user selects 'London', bot proceeds to next step.

phases.description: Bot asks for passport name, user provides valid name.
Bot asks for passport number, user provides valid number, validation workflow returns valid.
Bot asks for travel start date, user provides '15 May 2026', confirms, validation passes.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms and saves start date.

phases.description: Bot asks for return date, user provides '25 May 2026', confirms, validation passes.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms and saves return date.

phases.description: Bot triggers invitation letter email workflow, receives 'success', confirms to user.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot says confirmation message and resets variables.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
